name: Goose

surfaces.name: Goose desktop and CLI: skill folder

notes: Goose recommends the shared .agents/skills folders, so this target installs the same copy Codex and Gemini CLI read.
prerequisites: Python 3.10+ and Chromium for the engine

docs.title: Using skills (Goose)
docs.facts: Global ~/.agents/skills/, project .agents/skills/, plugin skills under ~/.agents/plugins/<name>/; also reads .goose/skills, .claude/skills, ~/.claude/skills and ~/.config/goose/skills. /skills lists and loads skills.
